parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the manager account that has the rds_superuser permission.

You can create an account on the Account Management page of the AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2361789.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
具有rds_superuser权限的管理账号名称。

您可以通过控制台->账号管理来创建账号，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2361789.html接口创建
parameters.name: manager_account

parameters.help_en: The password of the manager account
parameters.name: manager_account_password

parameters.help_en:
The name of the namespace. After the namespace is created, the system automatically creates an account that has the same name.

The name must comply with the naming conventions of PostgreSQL objects
parameters.help_zh:
要创建的命名空间名称，用于租户隔离（后端会自动创建同名的用户账号）。

名称需符合PostgreSQL对象名限制
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace that consists of multiple AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances. You must specify one of the WorkspaceId and DBInstanceId parameters. If you specify both parameters, the WorkspaceId parameter takes effect
parameters.help_zh: 多数据库实例组成的Workspace的Id。此参数和DBInstanceId参数不能同时为空，当和DBInstanceId同时指定时以此参数为准
